messages:
Ava Chen: Morning! Quick idea — cereal + bagel bar tomorrow at 8:30am in the courtyard? Bring a box of your favorite cereal or a bag of bagels. @channel :bowl_with_spoon: :bagel:
Ravi Patel: Love it. I can bring oat milk and some granola. :thumbsup:
Marta López: I have gluten-free bagels, will bring those. Also maybe coffee? :coffee:
Diego Rivera: I can grab a French press and a small speaker for chill tunes. What time should we start tearing into carbs?
Ava Chen: planning to start 8:30, wrap by 9:15 so people can head to standups.
Samir K.: Heads up — courtyard has a team yoga class at 9, so quick setup and cleanup recommended. I can handle cleanup duty. :broom:
Carly: I'm in. I'll bring a sweet cereal (you know the one) and disposable plates + napkins. :sparkles:
lunch-bot: Poll created: React with :bagel: if you prefer bagels, :cereal: if cereal, :coffee: if you want coffee only. (Replies will be counted via reactions)
Ravi Patel: reacted with :cereal:
Marta López: reacted with :bagel:
Diego Rivera: reacted with :bagel:
Ava Chen: reacted with :cereal:
Samir K.: Quick note — can someone bring a small cooler for milk? I have a transport tote but no ice.
Carly: I can bring a cooler + ice packs.
Ava Chen: Awesome. Also left a tiny sign-up doc in the thread: `https://docs.internal/redwood/lunch/cereal-bagel-230437` — add what you're bringing if you can.
Ravi Patel: Adding oat milk & spoons. Any allergy callouts other than GF?
Marta López: Nut-free requested for communal bowls pls. I'll label mine.
Diego Rivera: Can we put a tiny playlist together? Drop 2 songs in here and I'll queue.
Samir K.: Dropping `Beastie Boys - Intergalactic` and `Lizzo - Juice` :sunglasses:
Carly: `Fleetwood Mac - Everywhere` and `Daft Punk - One More Time`
Ava Chen: Perfect. See you all 8:25-8:30. Thanks everyone! :heart:
